ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund. Optionally direct the rider to the NS-7 RydeHELP fee-waiver channel within 30 days if she wishes to appeal on lateness grounds (no ETA-based free-cancellation rule exists).
ruling.reasoning:
NS-0 allocates the charge by who cancelled; the record shows cancelled_by = rider, so this case enters the NS rules through the rider-cancellation branch, i.e. NS-4, not through the driver-no-show branch NS-1/NS-2 [F2][NS-0]. Nothing in the record shows any driver no-show claim: the driver never pressed "I'm Here", no automatic arrival was logged, and driver_arrived_at is null [F3][F4][NS-1].

On that branch the fee turns on timing alone. The rider was matched at 17:12:00 and cancelled at 17:15:05, i.e. 185 s later, which is past the 3:00 free-cancellation line [F2]. NS-4 therefore makes the $6.61 fee stand, and the recorded charge is exactly the published $6.61 with no surge or other additive to strip out [F5][F6][NS-4]. The rider's own messages confirm a normal en-route cancellation: she asked "Are you near?" at 17:12 and the driver replied "Coming, about 5 min" at 17:13, on a complete, fully timestamped chat thread [F7][F8][F9].

The rider's argument that the fee must fall because the driver never came within 200 m of Bedok Mall [F1] fails as a matter of clause structure: NS-1's arrival and 3-minute-wait conditions are the prerequisites for charging a fee on a driver-initiated no-show cancellation, and NS-2's full refund is triggered by a failed no-show claim, which does not exist here [F1][F4][NS-1][NS-2]. Driver proximity is not an element of NS-4, and Ryde publishes no rule granting a free cancellation because a driver has not yet reached the pickup point (this record has no ETA field; the informational NS-8 rule of other operators is not citable) [F1][F3][NS-4]. The rider's remedy for lateness alone is the NS-7 human fee-waiver channel, not an automatic refund [F2][NS-7].

Congestion and weather do not change the outcome either way: band 4 (30–39 km/h) on Sims Avenue East is ordinary flow, well outside the band 1–2 "reasonable cause" evidence, and there were no incidents and no rain [F11][F12][F13][RD-4]. No safety or traffic-excuse clause is engaged.

Safety screen: I read every chat message, the driver's statement and the complaint. The messages are a pickup query and an ETA reply ("Are you near?" / "Coming, about 5 min"), the driver's statement is "The rider cancelled while I was still on the way", and the complaint is about the charge only — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, and nothing aimed abusively at the other party [F7][F8][F10]. Safety concern: none.
